name: Mailbox
description: Self-hosted email: receiving, forwarding, local mailboxes, webmail reader, IMAP sync, DKIM/SRS
author: Joinery

provisioners.label: Inbound mail server
provisioners.details: Provider-specific. For Postfix, verifies port 25 is listening locally. For webhook providers (Mailgun, etc.) this is informational — the provider's own infrastructure handles MX.

provisioners.label: Outbound mail relay for forwarding
provisioners.details: Forwarded messages are relayed out through this SMTP server.

provisioners.label: DNS records for inbound domains
provisioners.details: Each enabled inbound domain needs an MX record pointing here and an SPF record.

provisioners.label: Sealed mailbox search index (ext-sqlite3 + FTS5)
provisioners.details: A vault-holding mailbox's sender/subject/body columns are ciphertext at rest and cannot be searched in SQL; MailboxIndex builds a disposable, in-window-only FTS5 index instead.

provisioners.label: Content spam scanner (rspamd)
provisioners.details: Optional. rspamd milter scores inbound mail for content spam and stamps X-Spam; the router reads it into the spam verdict. Webhook providers supply their own spam signal instead.

provisioners.label: Hardened relay tunnel
provisioners.details: In smarthost mode compose sends leave through the relay over WireGuard. Runs a real SMTP submission handshake over the tunnel (EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT to a reserved domain, QUIT — nothing is sent): port 25 listens in both modes, so only accepting relay of an external recipient proves the submission listener is open. Fails until a relay provisioned inbound-only is rebuilt in smarthost mode. No-op in provider mode and on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: Relay spool draining
provisioners.details: The main box pulls sealed mail off the relay spool every cron pass. Verifies a pull ran in the last 10 minutes so sealed mail is reaching the inbox. No-op on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: Relay alias map fresh
provisioners.details: The relay validates recipients against a synced alias map. Verifies the map the relay is running matches the current domains/aliases, so a newly created alias is not bounced. No-op on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: Origin IP not in mail DNS
provisioners.details: Once a relay exists, the main box IP must not appear in any hosted domain's mail DNS (a single leak defeats the hidden origin). Checks every hosted domain's MX. No-op on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: Sent mail leaves via an API provider
provisioners.details: With the relay smarthost off (the default), compose sends leave through the configured provider's HTTP API so the box IP never enters the Received chain. Verifies that provider submits over an API, not SMTP. No-op in smarthost mode or on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: No origin leak in sent mail
provisioners.details: Scans the delivered headers of the most recent out-and-back origin-leak probe for the main box IP or hostname. No-op in smarthost mode, on colocated deployments, or until a probe has been round-tripped (run one from the Relay tab).
